info.title: Simple AI Gateway
info.description:
LLM API 网关 — 兼容 OpenAI API 协议，支持多供应商路由、熔断、限流、配额、动态配置管理与 Webhook 事件通知。

## API 分组
- **业务端点**: `/v1/chat/completions`, `/v1/models`
- **认证**: `/auth/*`
- **管理**: `/admin/*`
- **内部**: `/internal/*`
- **系统**: `/healthz`

## 认证方式
Bearer token: JWT (access token) 或 API Key

post.summary: Refresh an expired access token using a valid refresh token
Authenticate with username/password to obtain JWT tokens

get.summary: Readiness probe - process can serve traffic
Get daily usage summary for the current user
Get recent request logs for the current user
Get model cost distribution for the current user

ApiKeyToggleRequest.description: Request body for enabling or disabling a user API key
